TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT aloc.ACCTG_INVTRY_LOC_KEY as ACCTG_INVTRY_LOCATION_KEY , trim(upper(aloc.ACCTG_INVTRY_LOC_NM)) as ACCTG_INVTRY_LOCATION_NM , trim(upper(aloc.INVTRY_CMDTY_TYPE_NM)) as INVTRY_CMDTY_TYPE_NM , trim(upper(aloc.INVTRY_CMDTY_NM)) as INVTRY_CMDTY_NM FROM feladm.FEL_ACCTG_INVTRY_LOC_DIM aloc

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: ACCTG_INVTRY_LOCATION_NM = in_ACCTG_INVTRY_LOCATION_NM AND INVTRY_CMDTY_TYPE_NM = in_INVTRY_CMDTY_TYPE_NM AND INVTRY_CMDTY_NM = in_INVTRY_CMDTY_NM

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT f.ACCTG_MO_DAY_ID , f.INVTRY_LOC_ID , f.ACCTG_INVTRY_LOC_NM , f.JNT_OWNR_BSNS_ENTY_ID , f.INVENTORY_QY , f.INVENTORY_AT , ttl.sum_qty as sum_qty , ttl.sum_amt as sum_amt FROM feladm.FEL_FV_BEGBAL_FDR f inner join ( Select ACCTG_MO_DAY_ID, INVTRY_LOC_ID, sum(INVENTORY_QY) as sum_qty, sum(INVENTORY_AT) as sum_amt from FELADM.FEL_FV_BEGBAL_FDR group by ACCTG_MO_DAY_ID, INVTRY_LOC_ID ) ttl on ttl.ACCTG_MO_DAY_ID = f.ACCTG_MO_DAY_ID and ttl.INVTRY_LOC_ID = f.INVTRY_LOC_ID

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT iloc.INVTRY_LOC_KEY as INVTRY_LOC_KEY , trim(upper(iloc.INVTRY_CMDTY_NM)) as INVTRY_CMDTY_NM , trim(upper(iloc.INVTRY_CMDTY_TYPE_NM)) as INVTRY_CMDTY_TYPE_NM , iloc.INVTRY_PRMRY_FCLTY_KEY as INVTRY_PRMRY_FCLTY_KEY , iloc.INVTRY_SCNDRY_FCLTY_KEY as INVTRY_SCNDRY_FCLTY_KEY , iloc.INVTRY_LOC_ID as INVTRY_LOC_ID , iloc.SYSTEM_ID as SYSTEM_ID FROM feladm.FEL_INVTRY_LOC_DIM iloc
